description: Rothco’s historical colonial flag, also known as the Betsy Ross flag, is perfect for hanging on a porch, inside your home, or on a vehicle. Measuring 3’ X 5’, the original American flag is made of a durable polyester construction to withstand outdoor elements. Hang your 13 colonies flag anywhere with the two brass grommet holes located on one side of the flag.
